description: Add an external login provider (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, generic OIDC/SAML) to the app's login realm, so end-users can sign in with it. You need an OAuth client id/secret from the provider first. IMPORTANT: the response contains a redirect URI that the user must register in the provider's OAuth app — surface it to them. For generic 'oidc' also pass authorization_url and token_url.

client_id.description: OAuth client id from the provider

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret from the provider

display_name.description: Button label shown on the login page

name: runzero_create_identity_provider
title: Add login provider
